== English Anthology family comparison ==
In the Second Anthology wording, the opening timing modifies when you occupy an Endor or Rebel Base site. The Endor print puts the beginning-of-deploy-phase timing at the start of the entire instruction. Both texts require the qualifying site, allow up to five troopers with a one-Force discount and preserve the shuffle and the restriction on other character and starship deployments.
